status: Structure agreed and reflected in DESIGN.md section 5.5. Damage numbers are solved for consistency, not validated: no enemy exists to test them against.

conventions.scaling: A map, not a single stat. A hybrid class needs skills that draw on two stats at once, or half the investment that defines the class does nothing on any given skill.

target_modes.nearest_enemy: Fires at whichever enemy is closest.
target_modes.around_hero: Hits everything within range of the hero.
target_modes.self: Buffs, heals or moves the hero.

conventions.supports_auto_cast: Whether the player is allowed to set this skill to auto-cast. False for reactive skills, where firing on cooldown defeats the point.
conventions.max_level: Every skill caps at 5 for now. Worth revisiting once skill points have a budget.

balance.how_these_numbers_were_derived: Not eyeballed. Each damage skill was solved backwards from a target effective damage per second, then split into its three sources.

damage_split.why: Stats are the largest single contributor, which is the point of the design. Skill levels are the next largest so skill points feel worth spending — maxing a skill roughly doubles it. Flat base is small so a skill is never build-independent.

expected_targets_per_cast.why: Effective dps is per-cast damage times the enemies a cast is expected to touch mid-run. Without this, single-target skills look far stronger than they are in a swarm.

balance.reference_hero: Level 15, all 28 free points spent: a pure build reaches 65 in its primary stat; a hybrid reaches 52 primary and 25 in its second.
balance.power_is_a_total: For any skill that hits more than once, power is the total across all hits, not per hit.
known_gaps: Utility skills (target: self) were not solved this way — their power means percent, seconds or healing depending on the skill, so there is no common unit to balance against.
Enemy health and damage do not exist yet, so these targets are internally consistent but not yet anchored to anything real.
Cooldown reduction stacks from three sources (skill levels, the accessory slot, Arcane Surge) with only a 0.2s floor stopping it. Untested and a classic place for a build to break the game.
Single-target skills are structurally weak in a swarm game. The expected_targets numbers compensate on paper, which is why Shadow Strike hits for ~400 — worth sanity-checking once enemies exist.

skills.name: Whirl
skills.description: A clumsy spin that clips anything standing too close. Draws on all three offensive stats equally, so it stays usable whichever class you become.

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.description: Catch your breath and recover a chunk of health.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.description: A wide horizontal swing through everything in front of you.

skills.name: Bulwark
skills.description: Set your feet and take far less damage for a few seconds.
skills.effect: Power is read as percent damage reduction, capped at 70%, lasting 4s.

skills.name: Firebolt
skills.description: A fast bolt at the nearest target. Cheap, constant, reliable.

skills.name: Frost Nova
skills.description: A ring of ice that hurts a little and slows a lot.
skills.effect: Slows everything hit by 50% for 3s. The Mage's answer to being surrounded.

skills.name: Piercing Shot
skills.description: An arrow that punches through everything in a line.
skills.effect: Pierces all enemies along its path rather than stopping at the first.

skills.name: Swift Step
skills.description: A burst of speed to get out of a closing circle.
skills.effect: Power is read as percent move speed, lasting 3s.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.description: Spin continuously, hitting everything around you again and again.
skills.effect: Hits four times over 2s. Power is the total across all four, not per hit.

skills.name: Blood Frenzy
skills.description: The closer to death you are, the faster you swing.
skills.effect: Attack speed bonus scaled by missing health, lasting 6s. Rewards staying in the swarm.

skills.name: Meteor
skills.description: Call down a rock. It lands late and it lands hard.
skills.effect: 1s delay before impact, large radius. Enemies can walk out of it.

skills.name: Arcane Surge
skills.description: Everything comes off cooldown faster for a short window.
skills.effect: Power is read as percent cooldown rate, lasting 6s.

skills.name: Shadow Strike
skills.description: Blink to the target and hit it where it cannot see you.
skills.effect: Teleports the hero behind the target and always crits. Doubles as mobility, which is the real reason to take it.

skills.name: Vanish
skills.description: Drop out of sight. Nothing can target you while you are gone.
skills.effect: Power is read as tenths of a second of untargetability. Manual only: a panic button that fires itself is not a panic button.

skills.name: Flame Brand
skills.description: Set your weapon alight; every swing carries the fire.
skills.effect: Auto-attacks deal bonus fire damage equal to power for 8s. The skill that makes STR and INT worth having at once.

skills.name: Rune Slash
skills.description: A cut that leaves a burning sigil hanging in the air.

skills.name: Enchanted Volley
skills.description: Three arrows, each splitting into sparks on impact.

skills.name: Sigil Trap
skills.description: Leave a rune on the ground behind you. It waits.
skills.effect: Places a rune at the hero's position that detonates when an enemy touches it. Rewards kiting in circles.

skills.name: Flurry
skills.description: A rapid sequence of thrusts at whatever is nearest.

skills.name: Riposte
skills.description: Turn the next blow you take into one of your own.
skills.effect: Negates the next hit taken within 4s and reflects power as damage. Manual only: automated on cooldown it would almost always be spent on a hit that was not going to land.
